completedPages.notes: Flagship V-next rebuild. Primary flow reduced to 3 inputs; focused on monthly payment, interest/principal X-ray, amortization, rate sensitivity, optional LTV and refix scenario. Removed arbitrary affordability verdict and generic tax-savings calculation. Official 2026 sources and open benchmark data integrated.

V-next rebuild: fake-precision point estimate replaced by source-backed 2026 price band; added roof-area helper from dimensions/slope, explicit scope ledger, planning midpoint with reserve, and supplier-offer scope audit. Removed unsupported hardcoded regional multipliers and opaque internal unit-rate presets. Benchmark avoids duplicate reconstruction/new-build observations where the source uses the same public reference band.

V-next rebuild replaces opaque preset rates and unsupported regional multipliers with three separate jobs: broad public price reference, deterministic project-geometry material calculation, and supplier-offer scope audit. Reinforcement defaults to zero and must come from project data; no structural design is inferred. Final static, calculation, desktop/mobile and accessibility QA passed; skip link is hidden off-canvas until keyboard focus.

V-next rebuild removes opaque house/roof/terrain/region price multipliers and unsupported internal unit rates. Product separates planning from supplier-offer audit, preserves each public 2026 reference with its own scope, area definition and VAT context, and refuses to create a total where a safe comparable basis is missing. Final JS, calculation, structured-data, dataset, integration, desktop/mobile, menu, overflow and accessibility QA passed.

V-next rebuild replaces broad project-cost estimator and generic presets with a focused material takeoff. Uses manufacturer-declared consumption for six verified product presets, separates clean wall area, reserve, piece count and two pallet procurement views, and leaves price optional for the user to enter from a real supplier quote. Custom mode supports any brick/block and geometric consumption is explicitly a fallback behind the product technical sheet. Final static, deterministic calculation, interaction, responsive overflow and desktop/mobile visual QA passed.

completedPages.archetype: Concrete Pour Planner / multi-component volume + order logistics
completedPages.notes: Rebuilt around multiple geometry components, explicit reserve/order rounding, 6–8 m3 truck logistics reference, bag yield from primary manufacturer data, and no automatic concrete-class recommendation. QA covered all five geometry formulas, multi-component sum, direct-volume mode, reserve and rounding, 6–8 m3 trip range, bag-yield conversion, desktop 1614 px, mobile 390 px, menu, zero-volume handling, JSON-LD and local references.

completedPages.archetype: Shift Pay Inspector / time-first legal split + payslip audit
completedPages.notes: Full flagship V-next rebuild from the user job rather than the previous page structure. Primary flow is now time-first: legal regime + PHV + exact shift date/time -> minute-level night/weekend/holiday split -> separately declared overtime -> money vs compensatory leave -> payslip audit. Added visible overlap timeline, manual attendance mode, wage/plat/DPP-DPC decision boundaries, wage-overtime-included edge case, salary 50% rest-day overtime, shareable state, dynamic MPSV collective-agreement benchmark and explicit calendar/night-shift limitation. Reused the previously verified 52-row model dataset and 6-row MPSV IPP dataset. Playwright QA covered Friday-night overlap, holiday leave/cash, salary 50% overtime, DPP/DPČ overtime disable, desktop/mobile overflow and runtime errors.

nextCandidate.reason: Return to established V-next sequence after completion of the user-requested flagship rebuild. Bulk-material calculator needs its own volume/density/tonnes/logistics archetype.

globalDecisions: Do not mass-delete or noindex existing calculator portfolio solely because of AdSense rejection.
Do not use a fixed word-count target.
Do not mass-generate one universal V-next template.
Use current best recent pages as reference, not as a pattern to clone blindly.
After every 8–12 fully rebuilt calculators, run a site-level quality review before deciding on the next wave or AdSense re-review.
